title: 对接机制存在错误与引导问题
description: 对接机制存在错误提示、夹钳状态异常等问题，导致玩家无法顺利完成对接。
evidence: The tips are telling you to close clamps when they light up green but they never do
the comms are Beeping nonstop saying their is no docking port even after I just recieved docking clearance

evidence_items.quote: The tips are telling you to close clamps when they light up green but they never do
evidence_items.description: 对接时提示要求关闭夹钳，但夹钳从未亮起绿灯，导致无法完成对接。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 提示告诉你当夹钳亮起绿灯时就关闭它们，但它们从来不会亮绿灯

evidence_items.quote: the comms are Beeping nonstop saying their is no docking port even after I just recieved docking clearance
evidence_items.description: 获得对接许可后，通讯仍持续蜂鸣并提示没有对接端口。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 通讯器不停地哔哔响，说没有对接端口，即使我刚刚收到了对接许可
